description: This Java class provides the default implementation of the PubSubConfig interface, encapsulating configuration parameters for a pub/sub system such as seed, hash family size, restart delay, update interval, and force update probability. It includes methods to load configuration values, as well as standard overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.
